hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) python3 -m py_compile "$f" ;; esac; } 2>&1 || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/constants.py) python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from src.constants import MORATORIUMS_DF, LOCAL_BODIES_DF, LOCAL_OFFICIALS_DF
errs=[]
dups=MORATORIUMS_DF.duplicated(subset=['locality','state'],keep=False)
if dups.any():
    pairs=MORATORIUMS_DF.loc[dups,['locality','state']].drop_duplicates().values.tolist()
    errs.append(f'Duplicate moratorium (locality,state): {pairs}')
for name,df in [('LOCAL_BODIES_DF',LOCAL_BODIES_DF),('LOCAL_OFFICIALS_DF',LOCAL_OFFICIALS_DF)]:
    missing=df[df['source'].isna()]
    if len(missing):
        locs=missing[['locality','state']].values.tolist()
        errs.append(f'{name} missing source: {locs}')
if errs:
    print('\\n'.join(errs),file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
print('constants integrity OK')
" ;; esac; } 2>&1 || true
